jobs.title: AI Data Engineer
jobs.description:
AI Data Engineer

**US CITIZENS ONLY** Due to governmental contracts, our client can only hire US Citizens.

POSITION SUMMARY
Our client is building an AI-first data platform designed to support advanced analytics, automation, and AI-driven applications across the organization. The AI Data Engineer will own and build the underlying data infrastructure that makes this possible.
This is a hands-on, individual contributor role responsible for data pipelines, lakehouse architecture, governed datasets, and the data products that support AI and analytics. You will work at the intersection of modern data engineering and AI delivery, using tools such as Claude Code to accelerate development while maintaining strong standards for architecture, security, quality, and governance.
The ideal candidate is someone who views data infrastructure as a product—not simply a collection of pipelines—and takes ownership of reliability, scalability, data quality, and the experience of downstream consumers.

RESPONSIBILITIES
Own the Data Platform

Own Bronze / Silver / Gold data pipelines using Microsoft Fabric and OneLake
Design and maintain governed semantic layers supporting Power BI and downstream analytics
Ingest data from multiple source systems into Microsoft Fabric and Azure SQL with appropriate quality, security, and lineage controls
Implement data governance, security, and PII handling practices aligned with Entra ID
Expose curated datasets to AI agents through approved APIs, MCP servers, or similar interfaces
Use Claude Code and other AI coding tools to accelerate development while reviewing and validating all AI-generated code before production deployment
Orchestrate, monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize pipelines for reliability, performance, and cost
Manage Git-based version control and deployment pipelines across development, test, and production environments

Support Reporting and Data Requests

Support ad-hoc requests across Microsoft Fabric and Power BI, including report, dataset, and data-quality enhancements
Build and maintain paginated and operational reports
Write, debug, and optimize SQL for reporting, investigation, and troubleshooting
Use AI coding tools to investigate and diagnose platform, data-quality, and reporting issues
Support and optimize Power BI semantic models and DAX for downstream consumers

REQUIREMENTS
Required

Hands-on experience building and maintaining data pipelines in Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse architecture and OneLake
Strong understanding of Bronze / Silver / Gold medallion architecture and semantic-layer modeling
Experience with Azure SQL, ADLS Gen2, and data ingestion across multiple source systems
Understanding of data governance, security, and PII handling, including Entra ID
Experience exposing data products through APIs, MCP-style interfaces, or similar mechanisms for AI and analytics consumption
Current, hands-on use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code as part of your development workflow
Strong SQL and data-engineering fundamentals
US Citizenship required; no sponsorship or green card holders due to confidential data requirements

Strongly Preferred

Experience building data infrastructure supporting AI agents, machine learning models, or agentic workflows
Experience with Power BI and Direct Lake
Experience working within structured engineering standards, documentation-first workflows, and formal code-review processes
Exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers or similar AI data-access patterns

NOT REQUIRED
People management experience — this is an individual contributor role
Industry-specific domain expertise — the ability to learn the business and apply strong data-engineering fundamentals is more important

WHO THRIVES IN THIS ROLE
This role is a strong fit for someone who takes genuine ownership of data infrastructure. You don't just build pipelines when a ticket arrives—you think about the platform as a product with real users and downstream consumers.
You are already using AI tools to improve how you design, develop, troubleshoot, and ship software. You care deeply about data quality, governance, and reliability, while still moving quickly. You are excited by the opportunity to build modern data infrastructure that directly enables AI, analytics, and automation rather than maintaining a legacy environment.
If you're a hands-on data engineer who wants to play a meaningful role in building an AI-first data platform, this role offers the opportunity to have significant ownership and impact.

jobs.title: Quantitative Analyst
jobs.description:
Insight Global are seeking a Quantitative Analyst, Index Operations for a leading global financial markets and exchange organisation. This role sits within the Index Operations team and is focused on supporting the calculation, maintenance, validation, and distribution of U.S. equity and derivatives-based indices. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring the accurate and timely delivery of index products, supporting client queries, monitoring market data, and contributing to process improvements and automation initiatives.

This position requires 5 days onsite
in Chicago, Illinois
for a permanent
opportunity.

The Analyst will work closely with internal stakeholders, vendors, and clients to support daily index operations, incident management, corporate action monitoring, rebalances, quality assurance processes, and new product launches. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong analytical and problem-solving skills who is passionate about financial markets, quantitative analysis, and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities:

Support the daily calculation, maintenance, and dissemination of equity and derivatives-based indices
Monitor index delivery processes and resolve operational issues in a timely manner
Execute index rebalances and provide support during client-facing rebalance events
Validate index calculations, corporate actions, dividends, and reporting outputs
Investigate incidents, document findings, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives
Develop and enhance automation tools to improve operational efficiency
Support new index launches, enhancements, and change management activities
Provide high-quality client support, including onboarding, query resolution, and pricing challenges
Maintain operational procedures, controls, KPI reporting, and monitoring frameworks
Run and troubleshoot replication and calculation models within required timelines
Participate in quantitative modelling exercises and options pricing-related activities

Must-Have Requirements Include:

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline
Understanding of financial markets, index products, or market data environments
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a highly detail-oriented approach
Ability to interpret and apply quantitative or mathematical methodologies
Experience working with Microsoft Excel, including advanced functionality
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams
Experience conducting validation, quality assurance, or operational control activities
Comfortable managing multiple priorities within a time-sensitive environment

Plusses Include:

Exposure to derivatives, options, or volatility-related products
Experience with index calculation, maintenance, or benchmark administration
Knowledge of corporate actions and dividend processing
Experience with Python, R, or another programming language
Experience troubleshooting and debugging quantitative models
Exposure to process automation and workflow optimisation
Understanding of incident management, root cause analysis, and operational risk controls
Exposure to theoretical options pricing models or quantitative research methodologies

jobs.title: Data Science Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Title: Data Science Engineer

Location: Chicago, IL-Remote/Hybrid

About Us

At Predictive Sales AI (PSAI)
, we’re redefining how technology and intelligence transform digital marketing. Our AI-powered software enables home services businesses to make smarter, faster decisions—fueling growth through automation, prediction, and precision.

We are seeking a Data Science Engineer
with strong data engineering and MLOps expertise to build scalable, production-grade ML and data platforms that directly impact customer growth and retention.

Job Overview

As a Data Science Engineer
, you will design and operate the data + machine learning foundations behind PSAI’s predictive products. You will build scalable pipelines and robust warehouse/lakehouse models across CRM, marketing, product events, and external datasets — ensuring reliability, accuracy, and business continuity at scale.

This Role Requires

Key Responsibilities:

4+ years in data-centric engineering
Proven experience deploying ML models via pipelines
Deep expertise in Python, SQL, and Azure infrastructure
Architectural ownership through data contracts and resilient modeling
Build scalable batch and near-real-time ingestion pipelines using Azure Data Factory, APIs, event streams, and external connectors.
Develop ML-ready datasets across CRM, marketing automation platforms, product telemetry, and geospatial data sources.
Design performant, well-modeled warehouse/lakehouse systems in Azure Synapse or Databricks.
Train and deploy predictive models (lead scoring, churn prediction, forecasting) through reproducible pipelines.
Build time-aware, leakage-resistant feature pipelines for production ML use cases.
Support full MLOps lifecycle using Azure Machine Learning, including experiment tracking, model registry, and deployment.
Implement automated validation, anomaly detection, reconciliation, and monitoring for pipelines and warehouse models.
Design and enforce data contracts to prevent upstream schema changes from breaking downstream ML workflows.
Own pipeline SLAs, alerting, incident response, and durable improvements through postmortems.
Optimize processing for very large datasets (>100GB) through partitioning, incremental loads, distributed compute, and query tuning.
Improve cost efficiency across compute/storage in Azure environments.
Maintain clean, testable, production-ready Python codebases using:
Object-oriented patterns
Type hinting
CI/CD workflows via Azure DevOps
Package models and pipelines using Docker for consistent deployment across dev/staging/prod.
Communicate architectural trade-offs and technical debt in business terms to Product, RevOps, and leadership.
Partner with Engineering on instrumentation and scalable data integration.
Mentor junior engineers through pairing, code reviews, and documentation best practices.

Desired Traits

We are looking for an individual who is organized, proactive, and detail-oriented. In this role, you will work closely with teams across the company. Here’s what we’re looking for:

Ownership mindset with a reliability-first approach
Strong SQL/Python and a high attention to data quality
Scales systems thoughtfully (performance/cost aware, maintainable designs)
Collaborative communicator across engineering, RevOps, and analytics
Documents well and supports others through reviews/mentorship

Required Skills And Experience

Preferred Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a closely related quantitative field.
4+ years in data engineering, ML engineering, or data platform development.
Minimum 2 years deploying ML models into production workflows.
Experience building pipelines and warehouse systems at scale (>100GB datasets).
Demonstrated adaptability in fast-changing technical and business environments.
Python (Expert): pandas, polars, scikit-learn; PyTorch, transformers; production engineering (OOP, testing, typing)
SQL (Expert): advanced analytics, recursive CTEs, query tuning, Azure Synapse optimization
Azure Data & ML Stack: Data Factory (ETL/ELT), Azure ML (MLOps), Key Vault, Databricks/Spark, Docker deployment
Distributed & Large-Scale Compute: Spark, Ray, Dask; GPU acceleration with RAPIDS (plus)
Geospatial & Specialized Data: GeoPandas, Shapely, rasterio
AI Automation & LLMs: LangChain/Semantic Kernel, agentic workflows
DevOps & CI/CD: Azure DevOps pipelines, Gitflow, rebasing, clean version control

Why Join Us?

Innovative Environment: Be part of a forward-thinking company that values creativity and encourages the exploration of new ideas.
Professional Growth: Access opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement within a supportive and dynamic team.
Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy a competitive salary, performance-based bonuses, flexible work arrangements, and a robust benefits package.
Collaborative Culture: Work in a team-oriented environment where collaboration and mutual respect drive our success.

If you're ready to be part of an innovative, growth-oriented team, apply today!

jobs.title: Quantitative Researcher
jobs.description:
About Akuna:

Akuna Capital is an innovative trading firm with a strong focus on collaboration, cutting-edge technology, data driven solutions, and automation. We specialize in providing liquidity as an options market maker – meaning we are committed to providing competitive quotes that we are willing to both buy and sell. To do this successfully, we design and implement our own low latency technologies, trading strategies, and mathematical models.

Our Founding Partners first conceptualized Akuna in their hometown of Sydney. They opened the firm's first office in 2011 in the heart of the derivatives industry and the options capital of the world – Chicago. Today, Akuna is proud to operate from additional offices in Sydney, Shanghai, London, and Singapore.

What you'll do as a Quantitative Researcher at Akuna:

Akuna's Trading and Research teams are seeking Quant Researchers to join a multidisciplinary group of mathematicians, statisticians, technologists and traders. These teams drive the development of trading strategies and predictive models by combining quantitative rigor with deep expertise in financial markets. In this role, you will join one of our Quant teams based on your experience and interests, including Low Latency/MMS, Quant Strategy Research, Volatility & Pricing, Delta One and Quant Development.

We are looking for talented researchers who can apply and develop machine learning algorithms to contribute to Akuna's strategy portfolio. In this role, you will:

Develop trading strategies using statistical and machine learning algorithms
Drive improvements in predictive models through rigorous signal and feature research
Design and optimize machine learning workflows to support scalable, efficient, and reproducible research
Bring a results-driven mindset paired with strong collaboration and communication skills.

Qualities that make great candidates:

3+ years of strong professional work experience in statistics, machine learning or related area
BS/MS/PhD degree in a technical field – Engineering, Computer Science, Math, Physics, or similar
Proven research background in academic or professional environment
Programming experience in Python or C++
Expertise in statistics and machine learning
Financial experience or knowledge of trading is a plus
The ability to react quickly and accurately to rapidly changing market conditions, including the ability to quickly and accurately respond and/or solve math and coding problems are essential functions of the role

In addition to technical skillsets, Akuna values the unique perspectives people can bring to the table to collaboratively solve complex problems and drive Akuna forward. We want all groups to feel empowered to apply, even if you don't meet every qualification. We welcome your application and encourage you to take the first steps toward your future with us!

Please note that level/title, as well as team placement, will be determined upon the conclusion of the interview process. If you are a current student or recent graduate, please take a look at our Entry Level and Intern positions.

In accordance with Illinois Equal Pay Act, the minimum base salary starts at $145,000. Exact compensation offered may vary based on many factors including, but not limited to, the candidate's experience, qualifications, and skill set. This role is also eligible for a discretionary performance bonus as part of the total compensation package and includes a comprehensive benefits package that may encompass employer-paid medical, dental, vision, retirement contributions, paid time off, and other benefits. The minimum base salary herein was determined in good faith by Akuna Capital LLC.
